22. FITTER TRAINING TO HEARING IMPAIRED PERSONS 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Fitter training is given to the Hearing   Impaired 
candidates at the ITI, Guindy for 2 years.   A 
stipend   of Rs. 300/- pm is given to the trainees. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
1.    Hearing   impaired Person. 
2. Minimum Educational Qualification: 10th 
Passed. 
3. 
Whether form of application is 
prescribed. 
Yes, available with District Differently Abled 
Welfare Officer. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
Copy of : 
1. National Identity Card. 
2. Certificate for Educational Qualification. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application is 
to be submitted 
Commissioner for Welfare of  the Differently 
Abled. 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar Salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
